intro:
Are Your Bones Really Harder Than Steel?!
Become a Body Expert Through Fun Quizzes
description:
Discover surprising facts about the human body through fun and engaging quiz challenges!

・How many times do we blink in an hour?
・How many more bones does a baby have than an adult?
・If the Earth were flat, how far could the human eye see?

Learn fascinating trivia about the human body that you'll be excited to share with friends.

The game also includes a helpful Hint feature, making it enjoyable for players of all knowledge levels.

Looking for a fun and easy way to learn about the human body in your spare time? This game is a great place to start.

Recommended for people who:
・Love trivia and fun facts
・Want to expand their knowledge
・Enjoy testing themselves
・Like brain-training games while passing the time
・Dream of working in a medical or healthcare field

※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.
